build.vendored_slices_note: T08 (2026-09-16) implemented and verified only the native macos-arm64 slice end-to-end (real zig build + real ghostty_surface_* smoke). The macOS x86_64 half of the universal slice remains unbuilt but is plausible. The two iOS slices are NOT achievable at the pinned commit: T05 (2026-09-18, blocked) confirmed with the pinned Zig 0.16.0 toolchain that `zig build -Dtarget=aarch64-ios -Demit-xcframework=true` fails with `error: iOS is not a supported target for the full Ghostty build; only libghostty-vt supports iOS (-Demit-lib-vt)` (`src/build/Config.zig:140`), and that upstream commits `4f39c506e`/`396166ecb`/`b112f3954` (2026-08-12, all ancestors of this pin per `git compare` behind_by=0) deliberately removed the iOS app/embedder target from `GhosttyXCFramework.zig` before this pin was cut; `origin/main` as of 2026-09-18 has not reinstated it. Do not re-attempt `vendor` for ios-arm64/ios-arm64-simulator against this pin without first resolving the architecture decision recorded in the T05 queue row (re-pin to a pre-removal commit, fork/patch upstream, adopt libghostty-vt plus a new Clair-owned iOS renderer, or descope).
